fusions.name: Last Shaft
fusions.desc: Hurls a shaft that deals 32 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Fan of Points
fusions.desc: Throws 3 shafts at once, spread apart, each dealing 5 damage and knocking back what it hits by 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Long Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Doorway Aim
fusions.desc: Each critical hit throws a point at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
